title.narrative: CWA Wastewater Integration and Pipeline Rehabilitation Project

description.narrative: The project involves a corporate loan to CWA to support the (i) construction of a new "smart" wastewater treatment plant and associated sewage pipeline network in Ningxiang City, Hunan Province, (ii) rehabilitation of an existing wastewater treatment plant in Ningxiang City, Hunan Province, and (iii) rehabilitation of aging water supply pipelines across tier 3 to tier 5 cities within CWA's existing concession areas.
